descriptionEn: An apartment is offered for rent in Bregu i Diellit, Prishtina.
The apartment is located in the Standardi complex, built by Miri Construction, in a strategic location near Rruga B, schools, hospitals and main services.
The space includes a living room with kitchen, three bedrooms, bathroom, WC, pantry and balcony. The apartment has abundant natural light and is functionally organised, suitable for long-term living.
